matches.rationale: The finding directly attacks the same claim in Section 4.2 that fusion weights are positive and sum to 1, providing a formal counterexample showing this fails — the same locus (Eq. 10/11 adaptive weights) and same underlying inconsistency the ground truth flags, even though it frames it as a normalization violation rather than an asymmetric-formula issue.
No finding addresses causal masking or attention reallocation (Eq. 5); the sole finding concerns logits fusion weight normalization, a different locus and mechanism.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Detects the same claimed-but-false weight-summation property tied to the adaptive logits fusion in Section 4.2, matching GT1.
